test.create(writing)
test.create(writing::/writer::target)
test.create(writing::/writer::result)
test.create(writing::/writer::trigger)
writer.create(target::/inner::value)
writer.set_value(target::/inner::value, 4)
writer.create(target::/inner::copy)
writer.create(target::/inner::trigger)
inner.set_value(copy, value)
inner.destroy(trigger)
writer.set_value(result, target::/inner::copy)
writer.destroy(target::/inner::value)
writer.destroy(target::/inner::copy)
writer.destroy(trigger)
test.destroy(writing::/writer::target)
test.destroy(writing::/writer::result)
test.destroy(writing)
